# Process - Iteration 2

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | OVERWRITE_ORIGINAL_VALUES | 48527, 50768, 59196 | Agent clears cells in target range that should remain as they were in the original file. | BEHAVIORAL | Precision / Boundary Rule |
| 2 | FORMULA_TEXT_AS_VALUE | 46897 | Agent writes the formula text as a value when the instruction asks "How can I create a formula...". | KNOWLEDGE | Output Contract / Literal Value Rule |
| 3 | CALCULATION_ERRORS | 43436, 37456 | Agent computes wrong values (e.g., higher than expected) due to logic errors. | KNOWLEDGE | Precision / Analysis |
| 4 | OMISSION_OF_VALUES | 53647, 37456 | Agent fails to write values to some cells in the target range despite claiming to have done so. | BEHAVIORAL | Verification / Execution |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OVERWRITE_ORIGINAL_VALUES | BEHAVIORAL | prompt.md | Add rule to "Precision" section: leave cells as-is if they are not meant to be changed. | Yes - passing tasks don't clear existing data. |
| FORMULA_TEXT_AS_VALUE | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md | Clarify "Strict Literal Value Rule": compute results of formulas, not write the formula text unless explicitly asked for the string. | Yes - passing tasks don't write formulas. |
| CALCULATION_ERRORS | ROLE | prompt.md | Strengthen "Precision" and "Verify" to emphasize correctness of the logic. | Yes - passing tasks are correct. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 48527: cleared cells that should be kept → "leave them exactly as they are in the original file; do not clear them or overwrite them with None".
- 46897: wrote formula text as value → "compute the result the formula would produce... If the instructions explicitly ask for the formula text as the answer, write it as a literal string, but never as a functional Excel formula."
- 43436: computed wrong values → emphasis on logic correctness in "Precision".

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis and implementation.
- No subagents used.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The absolute prohibition of formulas.
- The mandatory read-back verification.
- Python-based computation.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- None.
